Gerard Amatin:

Could the Exordium region be (ab)used to haul goods more safely between trade hubs?

This region’s only two-way connection to the rest of the New Eden cluster will be a single stargate leading to Yulai, which is currently under construction. Four shipcasters, each within an embassy constellation held by one of the four major factions, will also allow one-way access to that faction’s sovereign territory.

posts.name: Vyktor Abyss
posts.cooked:
Just some thoughts and questions:

I like the changes but as previously said, Yulai (edit: and the Shipcaster pop-outs) appears like it will just became ganker central as it will be a dangerous new bottleneck for all newbies. So rather than distributed ganking you’re potentially localising and concentrating the ganking pain. This may conversely mean more new players being ganked after trying to move ‘all their stuff’ out of the starter zone for the first time and then losing ‘everything’ - which leads to a lot of quitting.

I would also like more info on Taxes - everyone hates taxes and putting higher taxes on a starter area seems again conversely effective. You want to encourage trade (by new players), activity and have less penalty for making say a big market mistake. The game should allow newbies to enjoy all their hard earned (but lower) bounties etc rather than having more of them vanishing in NPC corp taxes.

Obviously I realise you dont want this to be bounty farming bot haven or some gank free, zero tax replacement for Jita either - so how will your taxes or other mechanics work to prevent this?

You need to have a clear plan which players can’t circumvent to avoid both of these eventualities in place before opening the region.

Cheers.
